Selection procedure
Group photo at the selection workshop in February 2025.
MPI CPfS
Group photo at the selection workshop in February 2025.
MPI CPfS
Written applications will be considered by the supervisors of the projects applied for, and by a team selected from PIs at the participating institutions. Short-listed candidates will be invited for interview, either by video conference, in person or both, depending on circumstances.
Most of the IMPRS places will be allocated in a workshop in Dresden which we organise after each annual call for applications. For the recruitment cycle 2026/27, with a submission deadline for applications at 30 Nevember 2026, we plan to hold an in-person workshop from 22 - 24 February 2027 at the MPI CPfS. We will discuss the details of the workshop directly with invited candidates.
If we receive applications of prospective IMPRS students at a time which makes a participation in the next workshop inconvenient, we will find other ways to give the applicants an opportunity to present themselves.
Once the selection procedure is completed, we intend to give feedback to the applicants as quickly as possible.
Previous workshops
You can find articles and pictures from previous workshops in the News section. Impressions from the workshop in 2026 are available here.
